@jordan-ae please feel free to carry on your task here, as it is related and you've already done research
https://github.com/ubiquity/work.ubq.fi/pull/49

When errors occurs, an error toast should be shown in the UI describing the error to the user. 
Some example of use cases are:
- the user got rate limited
- the endpoint in unreachable
Currently, nothing is shown in these scenarios, which leads the user to think that the broken UI is normal.
Tasks to be carried out:
- show the toast properly when errors occur
- add related tests to avoid regression
Might want to remove the comments

@0x4007 But if you simply access the website as a logged-out user, should this be displayed? I know that this call will fail for anyone logged-out / not part of the org. It's an expected error because Octokit throws with a 404. Maybe should be caught and not thrown?
